truth_method: Manual visual transcription before first inference. Six columns, right to left, top to bottom. No upstream XML or canonical text used. Preserve 山ぎは/やみ/なほ/蛍 as written.

expectation.recognition: Strict Unicode edit distance including spaces/punctuation/column breaks; require fewer edits than same-image horizontal baseline. No model text replacement. Paper normalization remains opt-in.

limitations: Public upstream example may overlap model training. Development sample, not an unseen-model or production acceptance claim.
